prompt: Can you write acceptance criteria for this? As a team admin, I want to invite people by email so they can join my workspace. An invite expires after 7 days. Only admins can send invites; members see the Invite button disabled. Inviting an email that is already a member shows "This person is already in the workspace." The invite flow should be simple. Bulk invite by CSV is not part of this release.
agent: claude -p in an empty project outside the repository
answer:
## Acceptance criteria: Invite people by email

Requirement: A team admin invites people to the workspace by email; an invite expires after 7 days, only admins can send invites, members see the Invite button disabled, and inviting someone who is already a member shows a message.

### Main path
AC-1. Given a team admin, when they invite a person by email, then that person can join the admin's workspace. _As a team admin, I want to invite people by email so they can join my workspace_

### Validation and errors
AC-2. Given an email that already belongs to a member of the workspace, when it is invited, then the message "This person is already in the workspace." is shown. _Inviting an email that is already a member shows "This person is already in the workspace."_

### Permissions and roles
AC-3. Given a user who is not an admin, when they try to send an invite, then no invite is sent. _Only admins can send invites_
AC-4. Given a member, when they view the Invite button, then the button is disabled. _members see the Invite button disabled_

### Limits
AC-5. Given an invite sent more than 7 days ago, when the invited person tries to use it to join, then the invite is refused as expired. _An invite expires after 7 days_

### Open questions
- [blocking] Main path: What measurable value defines "simple" for the invite flow? Blocks: "The invite flow should be simple"
- [minor] Main path: How does the invited person receive the invite? Limits: From what moment are the 7 days counted?
- [minor] Limits: What does the invited person see when they open an expired invite? Validation and errors: What happens when an email that already has a pending invite is invited again?

### Out of scope
- Bulk invite by CSV. _Bulk invite by CSV is not part of this release_
